title: Customer Success Manager at SpotMe
body:
- Managed the largest portfolio of contracts value in EMEA as a single CSM ($1.5M) at the time. Mainly a sales role.
- Managed strategic relationships as an IT vendor with 30+ enterprises.
- Coordinated with the product, operations, and engineering to ensure SLAs were met and required improvements were delivered.
- Designed, implemented, and owned KPIs and success plans.
- Assessed risk events and handled communication in case of any accidents. Ran quarterly business reviews.

Proactively accomplished besides my main responsibilities:

- Created a tool allowing the sales team to create a mockup of our product with prospect’s branding **10x faster**.
- Wrote a case study showcasing the platform at our company event.
- Created a landing page for the new Cvent+SpotMe integration.

title: Product Designer at Price f(x)
body:
Increased sales at various enterprises through dynamic pricing.

- Led the product design since Series A investment (€4M).
- Created & executed the strategy on product redesign.
- Educated the team on design thinking and its benefits.
- Introduced the solution for product data analytics.
- Helped to hire another designer on the team.
- Interactive wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity design creation.
- Conducted user testing and user research.
- Reviewed & analyzed the shipping quality on all outputs.

title: Freelance
body:
Completed 100+ commercial projects for global clientele.

- From client acquisition, consulting to final delivery.
- Found ways to add value in customer's businesses.
- Crafted high quality experiences from idea to execution.
- Web/Mobile apps, landing pages, digital product design.
